definition: what the hearer gave the speaker was for the speaker's good
expansion: (situation benefit (CONTENT (situation give PERFECTIVE (ACTOR (term INTERLOCUTOR)) (RECIPIENT (term SELF)))) (RECIPIENT (term SELF)))
pragmatic conditions: after the hearer gave the speaker a resource, a record or a capability
constructed history: Constructed history: whatever an agent was given freely it called a gift, and saying that a gift had come became the thanks for anything given.
